subject.title: feat(dashboard): add unlisted OpenClaw Bay demo

question: Should ClawSweeper deploy and maintain the unlisted `/bay-demo` experience as a hosted production experiment?
rationale: The implementation fits the existing dashboard boundary, but accepting a large playful production surface and its ongoing operational ownership is a product choice that code review cannot make safely.

options.title: Sponsor the hosted experiment
options.body: Approve the unlisted read-only route after sufficient real-browser proof is added and the exact head passes normal gates.

options.title: Keep it as a local prototype
options.body: Retain the concept outside the hosted Worker until maintainers want to own its runtime, persistence, and asset surface.

options.title: Decline the new surface
options.body: Close the PR if the visualization does not provide enough operational value to justify ongoing production ownership.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the hosted experiment
recommendation.body: Approve the unlisted read-only route after sufficient real-browser proof is added and the exact head passes normal gates.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and most heavily maintained the current dashboard Worker and is the strongest available owner for the hosted-surface decision.
